source.description: How do you want to import your products?
source.csvHelp: A Shopify product export — either column vocabulary — or one of ours. <sample>Download sample CSV</sample>
source.store: Import from your old online store
source.storeHelp: We read the catalogue at its address and show you what is there. Nothing is written until you approve it.
source.productHelp: Paste the link to one product page. We read that page and nothing else on the site, and nothing is written until you approve it.

csv.title: Import products by CSV
csv.description: Rows sharing a handle become one product with its variants, so a Shopify export lands as the products it describes rather than a listing per line.
csv.tooLargeBody: CSV imports are capped at 5 MB. Split the file and retry.
csv.conflictTitle: Some of these products already exist
csv.conflictDescription: {conflicts} of the {total} products in this file already exist in your catalogue.
csv.conflictHeading: {count, plural, one {One handle in this file is already yours} other {# handles in this file are already yours}}
csv.skipHelp: Import only the products you don't have yet. Nothing you already sell changes.
csv.overwriteHelp: Replace the fields the file provides on the matching products. Fields it leaves out stay as they are, and variants it doesn't mention are kept.
csv.previewDescription: Nothing has been written yet. Check this product read the way you meant it, then import.
csv.summary: You will be importing {products} products with a total of {skus} SKUs and {images} images — {created} created, {updated} updated, {skipped} skipped.
csv.invalidHeading: {count, plural, one {One product cannot be imported} other {# products cannot be imported}}
csv.nothingReadable: Nothing in this file could be read as a product.
csv.publishNew: {count, plural, one {Publish the product this creates} other {Publish the # products this creates}}
csv.publishNewHelp: They go live regardless of the file's status column. Products you already have are never re-published.

url.title: Import from your old store
url.description: Give us the address and we read its catalogue. This writes nothing — you see what we found and approve it afterwards.
url.urlHelp: The storefront a customer would visit. Public http or https only.
url.platformHelp: Leave it on detect. Naming one only helps when detection has already got it wrong.
url.attest: I own this store, or I am authorised to move its data.
url.attestHelp: Nothing can check this for us, so we ask. Your answer is recorded with your account, the address and the time.
url.attestRequired: Confirm you may move this store's data before scanning.

product.title: Import a single product
product.description: Give us the product's own page and we read that one page. This writes nothing — you see what we found and approve it afterwards.
product.urlHelp: The product's own page — not a category, search or home page. Public http or https only. We follow no links from it.
product.urlIsHome: That is a store's home page. Paste the address of the product's own page.
product.attest: This product's content is mine — it is my own listing, for example on another platform I sell on — or I have the rights holder's permission to use it.
product.attestHelp: Importing someone else's listing without their permission, such as a competitor's product page, is not allowed. We can't verify this ourselves, so we ask. Your answer is recorded with your account, the address and the time.
product.attestRequired: Confirm that this product's content is yours, or that you have the rights holder's permission, before importing it.

progress.title: Store import
progress.notFound: That import could not be found.
progress.cancelledBody: Anything already written stays in your catalogue.
progress.scanAgainBody: A new scan is a new job, and your edits stay on this one. Once the new scan is ready you can bring them over. Each edit follows its product by your old store's own product id, so an edit whose product the new scan doesn't find is listed rather than moved onto a different product.

carry.title: {count, plural, one {Your previous scan has edits on # product} other {Your previous scan has edits on # products}}
carry.body: Bring them over to this scan. Each edit follows its product by your old store's own product id, so it lands on the right product even if the product's address changed. Photos you dropped come along too, wherever this scan still has them. Anything this scan doesn't have is listed rather than guessed at, and any field you've already changed here keeps your new value.
carry.bring: {count, plural, one {Bring over edits for # product} other {Bring over edits for # products}}
carry.matched: {count, plural, =0 {No edits matched a product in this scan.} one {Brought over edits for # product.} other {Brought over edits for # products.}}
carry.unmatched: {count, plural, one {# product from the previous scan couldn't be matched to one in this scan, so its edits stayed behind:} other {# products from the previous scan couldn't be matched to any in this scan, so their edits stayed behind:}}
carry.dropsNotCarried: {count, plural, one {# photo you dropped on the previous scan isn't in this scan at the same address, so it wasn't dropped here. If your old store now serves it at a new address, drop it again.} other {# photos you dropped on the previous scan aren't in this scan at the same addresses, so they weren't dropped here. If your old store now serves them at new addresses, drop them again.}}

counts.title: What the scan found
counts.matchedHelp: Products you imported from this store before. Approving updates them in place rather than creating a second copy.

images.title: Images
images.help: An image in transfer is not a failed one. Products stay usable while images move; failed or stuck ones need a retry or a drop.
images.issuesBody: Each of these is still at your old store. Retry one, or drop it so the product no longer waits on that URL.

review.title: Review before importing
review.body: Nothing has been written yet. This is what approving does.
review.willUpdate: {count, plural, one {Update # product imported from this store before} other {Update # products imported from this store before}}
review.willCreateUpTo: {count, plural, one {Create up to # product} other {Create up to # products}}
review.willUpdateUpTo: {count, plural, one {Update up to # product imported from this store before} other {Update up to # products imported from this store before}}
review.willTransfer: {count, plural, one {Move up to # image onto your storage} other {Move up to # images onto your storage}}
review.draftNote: Every product lands as a draft, and nothing you already have is deleted.

currency.title: That store prices in {source}. You trade in {shop}.
currency.body: This import cannot continue. Prices are not converted, and there is no way to import the numbers as written.
currency.blocked: This import cannot continue while the currencies differ.

missing.title: {count, plural, one {# product this scan did not find} other {# products this scan did not find}}
missing.body: You imported these from this store before and this scan did not return them. They are listed so you know. Nothing here has been changed or removed, and nothing on this screen removes them — a scan that half-failed looks exactly like a store that dropped a product.

done.title: Import finished
done.draftNote: Every product landed as a draft. Publish the ones you want live.

trace.title: What we tried
trace.body: Each way of reading this store, in the order we tried it, and what it answered.

progress.ready: An import from {host} is waiting for your approval.

errors.urlBlocked: That address can't be imported from. Check the store's URL, and use its public address rather than an admin or staging one.
errors.ownershipNotAttested: Confirm that you own this store, or are authorised to move its data, before scanning.
errors.rateLimited: Too many scans for now. Wait a little and try again — this ceiling protects the store you are reading as much as us.
errors.platformUnsupported: We can't read that platform yet. Export a CSV from it and upload that instead.
errors.noProducts: We reached that store, but it publishes no readable product data (no structured catalog or public feed). You can export your products as a CSV from your current store and upload the file directly instead.
errors.sourceUnreachable: We couldn't reach that store. Check it is online and open to the public, then try again.
errors.importFailed: The import stopped because of a problem on our side, not with your store. Try again.
errors.currencyMismatch: That store prices in a different currency from yours. This import cannot continue — prices are not converted.
errors.tooLarge: That catalogue is too large to import in one run.
errors.invalidState: This import isn't at a stage where that is possible. Reload the page.
errors.artifactExpired: The previous scan has expired, and its edits are no longer kept. They can't be brought over.
errors.providerNotConfigured: Importing from that store is unavailable right now.
errors.planQuota: Your plan's store imports for this period are used up.
errors.featureNotAvailable: Store import isn't included in your current plan. Moving to a larger plan enables it — retrying will not.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
